claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.none
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has repeatable Bonus Action activations with no use-count or charge pool. The current activation family requires every activated ability to consume a use_count or charge_pool resource, so unlimited item toggles cannot be authored honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet, either as a Bonus Action ... or you can extinguish the light as a Bonus Action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface already has an alter_item_kind effect atom, but activated phases cannot currently target the held weapon itself. Quarterstaff of the Acrobat changes the item's own form, not the wielder or another creature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Light emission with explicit radius is a deterministic rules-facing effect. No existing effect atom covers creating or extinguishing dim light from an item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several riders apply only in named weapon forms. Existing passive gating can check armor categories or coarse weapon kinds, but not the current form of a specific transforming item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only) ... Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_weapon_property
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item temporarily changes its weapon profile by granting the Thrown property with explicit ranges, and it also returns to the wielder's hand after the ranged attack. That is not representable with existing effect atoms like modify_roll_numeric, modify_damage_numeric, or alter_item_kind.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.
